description: This PHP file contains unit tests for the CustomerAPI class, specifically testing the API endpoints related to customer data such as retrieval, creation, update, and deletion within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. The class employs data providers for test parameters and makes use of mock services to test API behavior in isolation.
